watch_list.title: AMD's CFO Presentation Insights
watch_list.rationale: A CFO's presentation at a technology conference often provides forward-looking statements, strategic priorities, and financial outlook that can influence investor sentiment. This event could offer clarity on AMD's strategy given Nvidia's strong results and AMD's recent product launches.
watch_list.trigger: Comments from AMD's CFO regarding market share, supply chain strategy, or future financial guidance during the Bank of America Global Technology Conference.

watch_list.title: Market Reception of AMD MI325X Accelerator
watch_list.rationale: The successful adoption and market feedback for AMD's new MI325X accelerator are crucial for its competitive standing against Nvidia. Initial orders or public statements from partners or key customers would indicate its immediate impact.
watch_list.trigger: Announcements of significant orders for the MI325X or positive reviews/benchmarks emerging from its deployment.

watch_list.title: Supermicro AI Product Shipment Updates
watch_list.rationale: Supermicro shipping new AI products, including those with Nvidia and AMD components, provides a real-time pulse on enterprise demand for AI infrastructure. Any updates on shipment volumes or customer uptake can indicate the blended market demand for both major chipmakers.
watch_list.trigger: Further announcements or reports from Supermicro regarding the uptake or performance metrics of their new AI products featuring AMD and Nvidia components.

watch_list.title: AMD's EFB Packaging Chain Progress
watch_list.rationale: AMD's strategic move to diversify its packaging supply chain is a long-term play to reduce reliance on CoWoS and mitigate future supply risks. Progress in this area could significantly enhance AMD's production stability and capacity.
watch_list.trigger: Reports or statements indicating concrete advancements or partnerships in AMD's development of the Taiwan EFB packaging chain.
